args:
( original=$(cmd uimode night) || exit; original=${original##* }; case "$original" in yes) target=no;; no|auto) target=yes;; *) exit 1;; esac; cleanup() { status=$?; trap - EXIT; cmd uimode night "$original" >/dev/null || status=1; restored=$(cmd uimode night) || status=1; restored=${restored##* }; printf "restored: %s
" "$restored"; [ "$restored" = "$original" ] || status=1; exit "$status"; }; trap cleanup EXIT; printf "original: %s
" "$original"; cmd uimode night "$target" >/dev/null || exit; changed=$(cmd uimode night) || exit; changed=${changed##* }; printf "changed: %s
" "$changed"; [ "$changed" = "$target" ] || exit 1 )
calls.stdout:
original: no
changed: yes
restored: no
